description: Returns the published availability of one District workspace: whether it is available now, available from a date, needs confirming or unavailable, how many desks it holds, and its published price. Optional inputs: desks (the team size), to learn whether it holds them, and startMonth (YYYY-MM), to learn whether it is free in time. This is the operator's published availability, the same as the District listing page shows. needs_confirming means the operator has not confirmed the space is free for that time, so it is not a statement that the space is available. requestViewingUrl is the District listing page, where viewings are requested. Read only: it cannot book, enquire or show contact details.

desks.description: Team size, to check the listing holds them

startMonth.description: Month the team wants to move in, as YYYY-MM

name: get_availability

availableFrom.description: First day an occupier could move in (YYYY-MM-DD), when known

calendarConfirmedThrough.description: The operator has confirmed the calendar up to this day (YYYY-MM-DD), or null

meetsStartMonth.description: True if in time for the start month asked, false if not, null if no month was asked or it is not confirmed

status.description: needs_confirming: the operator has not confirmed the space is free, so it is not a statement that it is available

fits.description: Whether it holds the desks asked; null when none were asked

requestViewingUrl.description: The District listing page, where viewings are requested

title: Check District Availability
